title: CI executes structured validation and aggregate integrity audit
changes: CI still runs the standard unittest suite and human-readable continuity.py validate.
CI now runs continuity_validate_json.py --root . for machine-readable non-mutating validation.
CI now runs continuity_integrity.py --audit-all --root . for aggregate event and transaction integrity coverage.
reason: The repository already exposes structured validation and aggregate integrity auditing, but CI previously verified only the human-readable validator. Making both machine contracts mandatory reduces silent drift between runtime behavior and tested behavior.
